definitions.explanation: The ability to see through appearances and judge the true value or nature of things. A refined, literary word.

examples.japanese: {眼識|がんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a person with a discerning eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美術品|びじゅつひん}→美術品：28549_bijutsuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{眼識|がんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: She has a keen eye for art.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{培|つちか}った→培う：07926_tsuchikau⟧{眼識|がんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The discernment cultivated through years of experience really counts.

notes:
A literary, somewhat formal word composed of {眼|がん} (eye) + {識|しき} (discernment, knowledge). It implies a trained or naturally sharp ability to judge quality, authenticity, or character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {眼識|がんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a discerning eye
- {眼識|がんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have refined discernment
- {眼識|がんしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to excel in discernment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鑑識眼|かんしきがん}: connoisseur's eye — emphasizes expert evaluation ability
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: an eye for things — everyday equivalent
- ⟦{審美眼|しんびがん}→審美眼：18905_shinbigan⟧: aesthetic sense — specifically about beauty
- ⟦{洞察力|どうさつりょく}→洞察力：08523_dousatsuryoku⟧: insight, perceptiveness — broader; not limited to visual judgment
